title: Awakening of Insects
prompt: Describe the significance of the Awakening of Insects in early March.
hint: Think about how nature changes and what the thunder symbolizes.
sample: The Awakening of Insects marks the time when thunder wakes insects and other animals from their winter sleep, signaling the arrival of spring.
